name: cache-timer
description: Claude Code mod that counts down the prompt cache, compacts a large conversation just before it expires, and can push a reminder to your phone.

auto_compact.title: Auto-compact before expiry
auto_compact.description: Compact a conversation above the threshold shortly before its cache expires.

threshold_k.title: Auto-compact threshold (k tokens)
threshold_k.description: Compact before the cache expires only when the context holds at least this many thousand tokens.

notify.title: Notify before expiry
notify.description: Send a push notification shortly before a 1-hour cache expires.

notify_lead_minutes.title: Notification lead time (minutes)
notify_lead_minutes.description: How many minutes before a 1-hour cache expires to send the notification.

cache_ttl.title: Cache lifetime
cache_ttl.description: auto infers 5m or 1h from cache hits; 5m or 1h pins it.

lead_seconds_1h.title: Lead time for a 1h cache (seconds)
lead_seconds_1h.description: How long before a 1h cache expires to start compacting.

lead_seconds_5m.title: Lead time for a 5m cache (seconds)
lead_seconds_5m.description: How long before a 5m cache expires to start compacting.
